lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn2Mn8S16 (reduced formula ZnMn4S8) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn and Zn centers each coordinated by six S neighbors in octahedral motifs, while S centers exhibit a single geometric neighbor. Corner-sharing between Mn and Zn octahedra is observed, alongside edge-sharing among Mn octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
